research_status: Staging research leads for Thailand catalogue foundation. Not a verified inventory. Prefer Helm Admin editorial curation before publish.

country.name: Thailand
country.note: Apply-time prerequisite: geo.countries must include TH and pricing.currencies must include THB (not present in default seed.sql as of this dataset).

destination.name: Phuket
destination.type_note: Editorial type only — catalog.destinations has no destination_type column; not imported as a typed enum.
destination.parent_note: Editorial parent label. Import format does not set parent_id; countryCode TH is required at apply time.
destination.summary_en: Andaman island hub spanning Patong, Kata/Karon, Phuket Old Town, and the quieter north-west beaches — not one walkable resort.
destination.summary_ar: مركز جزر أندامان عبر باتونغ وكاتا/كارون والبلدة القديمة والشواطئ الشمالية الغربية — ليست منتجعاً واحداً قابلاً للمشي.

geography_note: Patong, Kata/Karon, Rawai/Nai Harn, Kamala/Surin/Bang Tao, and Phuket Town are separate clusters. Do not treat the island as one walkable beach strip.

integrity.accommodation_import: Only accommodationType mapped; starRating and amenities omitted until verified
